beach.title: Sri Lanka Luxury Beach Holidays
beach.description: Surrender to 1,300 kilometers of sun-blessed coastline, secret golden coves, and crystal sapphire waters. From peaceful private seaside villas to blue whale safaris and world-class surfing, experience coastal Sri Lanka crafted entirely around you.
beach.overviewTitle: Golden Sands, Living Oceans & Secluded Luxury
beach.overviewText: Surrounded by the warm waters of the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is a year-round paradise for beach lovers. Thanks to the island's unique twin-monsoon rhythm, golden sunshine and gentle swimming waters can be found along our shores in every single month of the year.
beach.mapDescription: Explore our curated coastal journeys across secluded southern bays, historic rampart harbors, eastern surf lagoons, and pristine northern sandbars.
beach.seoTitle: Sri Lanka Beach Tours & Luxury Coastal Holidays | Lotus Ceylon
beach.seoDescription: Discover bespoke Sri Lanka beach holidays with Lotus Ceylon. Private luxury beachfront villas, whale watching, surfing, and tranquil bays.

cultural.title: Sri Lanka Cultural Tours
cultural.description: Journey across 2,500 years of living history. From sky palaces perched atop dramatic monadnocks to candlelit evening temple pujas and ancient royal reservoirs, immerse in the authentic soul of Ceylon with our bespoke, private guided cultural expeditions.
cultural.overviewTitle: Ancient Kingdoms, Sacred Shrines & Timeless Traditions
cultural.overviewText: Step into an ancient realm where sacred bodhi trees have been lovingly tended for millennia, where giant stone Buddhas gaze serenely over forest monasteries, and where evening temple oil lamps flicker to the hypnotic rhythm of traditional drums.
cultural.mapHeading: Discover Sri Lanka’s Timeless Cultural Routes
cultural.mapDescription: Follow the historic cultural route through sacred cities, rock-cut cave temples, traditional villages, and UNESCO World Heritage sites.
cultural.seoTitle: Sri Lanka Cultural Tours & Sacred Heritage Expeditions | Lotus Ceylon
cultural.seoDescription: Experience 2,500 years of living heritage. Sigiriya Rock Fortress, Temple of the Tooth, ancient kingdoms, and private chauffeur-guided luxury tours.

wildlife.title: Sri Lanka Wildlife Safaris
wildlife.tagline: ASIA’S APEX WILDLIFE • THE BIG FIVE SANCTUARY
wildlife.description: Encounter earth’s highest leopard density, dramatic elephant gatherings of 300+ gentle giants, elusive sloth bears, and the colossal blue whale. Experience Sri Lanka’s untamed nature in luxury tented safari camps with private expert naturalists.
wildlife.overviewTitle: Dense Jungle Tracks, Apex Predators & Oceanic Giants
wildlife.overviewText: Ranked among the world’s top 10 biodiversity hotspots, Sri Lanka packs astonishing faunal diversity into a compact emerald isle. Within a few hours' drive, you can transition from tracking leopards across Yala’s thorny scrub jungles to observing massive elephant herds grazing along ancient Minneriya reservoirs.
wildlife.mapHeading: Discover Sri Lanka’s Untamed Wildlife Routes
wildlife.mapDescription: Follow our carefully planned wildlife routes connecting the premier national parks, marine corridors, and pristine rainforest sanctuaries of Ceylon.
wildlife.seoTitle: Sri Lanka Wildlife Safaris & Big Five Wilderness Expeditions | Lotus Ceylon
wildlife.seoDescription: Embark on ethical private wildlife safaris in Sri Lanka. Track Yala leopards, witness the Minneriya elephant gathering, and spot blue whales.

highlights: Private ocean safari off Mirissa tracking colossal blue whales & spinner dolphins
Walk along the secluded crescent beaches and coconut palm hills of Tangalle
Private guided sunset walking tour along the 17th-century ramparts of UNESCO Galle Dutch Fort

itinerary.title: Arrival in Paradise • Tropical Warmth in Negombo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport where your private Lotus Ceylon chauffeur guide warmly welcomes you with fresh lotus blooms. Transfer to your seaside boutique hotel in Negombo to unwind by the pool and enjoy your first authentic coastal sunset.

itinerary.title: Scenic Southern Highway • Tangalle’s Secluded Bays
itinerary.description: Journey south along the scenic expressway towards Tangalle, famed for its untouched golden beaches and whispering palms. Check into your luxury oceanfront pavilion. Afternoon at leisure listening to the rhythm of the Indian Ocean.

itinerary.title: Hummanaya Natural Geyser & Mulgirigala Monastic Rock
itinerary.description: Witness the dramatic Hummanaya natural sea blowhole sending spray 30 meters skyward. Later, explore the tranquil 2,000-year-old Mulgirigala rock monastery tucked into lush coconut forests.

itinerary.title: Coastal Drive to Mirissa • Sunset at Coconut Tree Hill
itinerary.description: Drive west along the picturesque coastline to Mirissa. In the late afternoon, take a gentle walk up Coconut Tree Hill for an iconic panoramic view of the turquoise bay framed by slender palms.

itinerary.title: Gentle Ocean Giants • Blue Whale Marine Safari
itinerary.description: Board a private chartered boat at sunrise into the deep oceanic trench off Mirissa. Accompanied by our marine naturalist, encounter the world's largest mammal—the magnificent blue whale—along with pods of playful spinner dolphins.

itinerary.title: Unawatuna Bay & Living Heritage of UNESCO Galle Fort
itinerary.description: Travel to historic Galle. In the afternoon, embark on an insider's walking tour of the 17th-century Dutch Fort with a local heritage historian, strolling cobblestone alleys lined with artisan jewelers, colonial mansions, and bastions overlooking the ocean.
itinerary.overnight: Galle Fort Heritage Suite or Beachfront Resort

itinerary.title: Stilt Fishermen of Koggala & Coastal Artisan Ateliers
itinerary.description: Witness the timeless practice of stilt fishermen balancing skillfully above the coastal breakers at Koggala. Visit an intimate cinnamon peeling plantation and traditional lace-weaving ateliers.
itinerary.overnight: Galle Fort Heritage Suite or Beachfront Resort

itinerary.title: Bentota Coastal Sanctuary • Madu River Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Head northward to Bentota's golden ribbon of beach. Enjoy a peaceful motorized boat cruise along the mangrove canopies of the Madu River wetland, visiting a quiet cinnamon island and bird sanctuaries.

itinerary.title: Kosgoda Sea Turtle Sanctuary & Beachfront Leisure
itinerary.description: Visit the renowned Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Project to learn about protecting endangered sea turtles. Spend your final coastal evening with a private candlelit seafood dinner served under the palms right beside the waves.

itinerary.title: Colombo Heritage Drive • Farewell to Ceylon
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning swim followed by a scenic transfer to Colombo for light shopping and colonial sightseeing before arriving at the airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Pigeon Island Marine Sanctuary Snorkeling Expedition
itinerary.description: Take a short speedboat ride to Pigeon Island National Park. Put on your snorkel to marvel at vibrant staghorn corals, sea turtles, and docile reef sharks swimming in crystalline warm water.

itinerary.description: Spend a peaceful day swimming in calm glass-like waters, paddle-boarding, or indulging in signature coconut oil Ayurvedic massages by the sea.

itinerary.description: Travel southward along scenic rural roads to Arugam Bay, consistently ranked among the world's top ten surf destinations, surrounded by wild lagoons and peaceful village life.

itinerary.title: Dawn Waves & Elephant Lagoon Safari at Pottuvil
itinerary.description: Catch early morning waves at Main Point or Baby Point with a licensed instructor. In the late afternoon, embark on an authentic lagoon canoe safari through Pottuvil Lagoon to spot wild elephants bathing on the banks.

itinerary.title: Kudumbigala Forest Hermitage & Panama Dunes
itinerary.description: Visit the ancient rock monastery of Kudumbigala rising high above the jungle canopy, followed by an evening walk along the dramatic, windswept sand dunes of Panama.

itinerary.title: Highland Foothills Transit toward Central Country
itinerary.description: Begin the return journey with a scenic inland drive through the foothills of the central highlands, enjoying majestic waterfall views and cool mountain breezes.

itinerary.title: Colonial Colombo Cosmopolitan Evening
itinerary.description: Descend to vibrant Colombo. Enjoy an evening walk through the historic Old Dutch Hospital precinct and sunset drinks overlooking Galle Face Green.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Sri Lanka • Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Following breakfast and final souvenir shopping for premium Ceylon tea and handcrafted treasures, transfer comfortably to the airport for your flight home.

itinerary.description: In the afternoon, enter Minneriya National Park in an open-top 4x4 jeep to witness the world-renowned 'Gathering'—hundreds of wild elephants grazing, bathing, and playing with their young calves along the reservoir.

itinerary.title: Highland Edge Transit toward Yala National Park
itinerary.description: Travel southward along scenic routes toward Yala on the southeast coast, passing rural villages and mountain backdrops. Check into your luxury wilderness lodge or tented camp bordering the park.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Yala Leopard & Sloth Bear Tracking
itinerary.description: Experience dawn and late-afternoon private game drives in Yala Block 1 with our expert tracker. Search for the elusive Sri Lankan Leopard, sloth bears, wild boars, and saltwater crocodiles basking along coastal lagoons.

itinerary.title: Bundala Wetland Birding Sanctuary & Colombo
itinerary.description: Morning safari at Bundala National Park, a UNESCO Ramsar wetland home to thousands of migratory flamingos, pelicans, and waterbirds. Drive comfortably along the southern highway to Colombo.

itinerary.title: Departure from Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and a city drive before your private chauffeur guide transfers you to the airport for your onward flight.

itinerary.description: Drive northward to Wilpattu National Park. Afternoon 4x4 safari traversing sand trails and scenic villus to spot sloth bears and leopards.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Wilpattu Deep Wilderness Drive
itinerary.description: Spend an entire day immersed in Wilpattu’s untouched wilderness with packed bush breakfast and lunch under shaded mahogany trees.

itinerary.title: Transit to Habarana • Minneriya Elephant Gathering
itinerary.description: Drive to Habarana. In the late afternoon, embark on an open 4x4 safari at Minneriya or Kaudulla to witness hundreds of wild elephants.

itinerary.title: Minneriya / Hurulu Eco-Park Safari & Night Jungle Walk
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure at your jungle resort. Afternoon safari in Hurulu Eco Park. Evening guided night walk to spot the rare Grey Slender Loris.

itinerary.title: Scenic Route to Udawalawe National Park
itinerary.description: Travel southward toward the dry-zone plains of Udawalawe, home to dense resident herds of wild elephants.

itinerary.title: Elephant Transit Home & Udawalawe Reservoir Safari
itinerary.description: Visit the Born Free-supported Elephant Transit Home during morning feeding. Afternoon 4x4 safari across Udawalawe’s open grasslands.

itinerary.title: Yala Block 1 & Block 5 Leopard Safaris
itinerary.description: Morning and afternoon game drives in Yala tracking leopards, jackals, sambar deer, and marsh crocodiles.

itinerary.title: Coastal Route to Mirissa Whale Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Drive along the southern coastline to Mirissa. Relax on golden beaches and enjoy fresh seafood dining under coconut palms.

itinerary.title: Blue Whale & Sperm Whale Oceanic Safari
itinerary.description: Private sunrise boat charter into the deep submarine canyon off Mirissa, tracking blue whales, sperm whales, and leaping dolphin super-pods.

itinerary.description: Leisurely morning followed by an afternoon walking tour of historic Galle Dutch Fort and sunset drinks overlooking the Indian Ocean.
